decision: Admit stacks/winui.csv L34 ('Support keyboard navigation') as SPLIT singleton instructions per SR-111 and the D56 subspan amendment. The review entry's familyIds linkage is resolved OUT of family family-support-keyboard-navigation-b8dc783f: SR-105 and D58 categorically exclude SPLIT rows from families and family bindings are whole-cell only (SR-103), so split units cannot be family variants. Analysis: .tmp/winui-l34-analysis/analysis.md. The Don't cell 'Mouse-only interactions' is a row-level shared exception bound to both units and labeled as such; the Code Good cell ('<Button AccessKey="S" Content="Save"/>') is bound only by the access-keys unit whose norm it illustrates. The Applies To cell (col 10, metadata-applicability) is covered whole-cell by each unit's conditions_applies_when; corpus bindings are restricted to normative-* cells per D56 §6.1, so its coverage is recorded in this coverage table rather than as a binding cell (L57 precedent).
